name: DDNet Dedicated Server
description: Install the DDNet dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Linux server binary directly.
known_limitations: The Pelican Egg's generated configuration is not imported; configure advanced DDNet settings in the server files after provisioning.
Linux console interrupt handling is not exposed by the Native runtime, so stop uses the bounded terminate fallback.

requirements.description: The reviewed Pelican launch targets the native Linux server.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.

help.summary: GameNode installs Steam App 412220 anonymously and launches DDNet-Server without a shell.

findings.summary: Pelican's generated DDNet configuration is not part of the safe SteamCMD template contract.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers
